_source: Build 1.74.0.0.104319, read with TACTLib/TankLib (scratch tool physdump): per map the keys of its ENTITY placeable chunk (0x0DD0000B << 32 | map index); the entity definitions (003) whose STUModelComponent model has physics shapes that stop the character mover, and that model (not the client-only breakables: STUModelComponent m_breakableConfig m_clientOnly = 1, physics only the client runs, so they cannot stop the server's mover); the models' keys; each game mode's m_A43573F4 identifiers (a placeable with an identifier exists only in the modes that list it). ekey = encoding key, ckey = MD5 of the file.
